system/io.vectory.update = {
	active count = 0
	path = /Library/LaunchDaemons/io.vectory.update.plist
	type = LaunchDaemon
	state = not running

	program = /Library/Application Support/Vectory/update-state/private/helper/vectory
	arguments = {
		/Library/Application Support/Vectory/update-state/private/helper/vectory
		update-helper
		--state-dir
		/Library/Application Support/Vectory/agent
	}

	stdout path = /dev/null
	stderr path = /Library/Application Support/Vectory/update-state/private/step.log
	default environment = {
		PATH => /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
	}

	environment = {
		PATH => /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
		XPC_SERVICE_NAME => io.vectory.update
	}

	domain = system
	minimum runtime = 10
	exit timeout = 5
	runs = 13
	last exit code = 0

	spawn type = daemon (3)
	jetsam priority = 40
	jetsam memory limit (active) = (unlimited)
	jetsam memory limit (inactive) = (unlimited)
	jetsamproperties category = daemon
	jetsam thread limit = 32
	cpumon = default
	run interval = 30 seconds
	probabilistic guard malloc policy = {
		activation rate = 1/1000
		sample rate = 1/0
	}

	properties = runatload | inferred program | system service | tle system
}
